exclusions.reason: GitHub-hosted PR suite (typecheck, handbook completeness, e2e completeness, screenshot baselines, Vitest coverage, production build). This public repository does not measure that work locally.

This job runs Playwright end-to-end behavior tests as three GitHub-hosted matrix shards (1/3, 2/3, 3/3) inside the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-noble container against Linux Chromium baselines and is not measured locally as an A38 author report.
This job runs no tests. It is the required check E2E (behavior) and only reports whether every behavior shard of the e2e job succeeded.

This job runs Playwright visual regression tests as GitHub-hosted matrix shards (two per project for desktop-light, desktop-dark, mobile-light, mobile-dark) inside the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-noble container against Linux Chromium baselines and is not measured locally as an A38 author report.
This job runs no tests. It is the required check Visual (<project>) for each of the four projects and only reports whether every shard of the visual-shards job succeeded.
This job builds and pushes a production Docker image and dispatches a deploy to the DEV environment, a production-credential path that is not an author-measured test.
This job builds and pushes a production Docker image and dispatches a deploy to the staging environment, a production-credential path that is not an author-measured test.
This job builds and pushes a production Docker image and dispatches a deploy to the PRD environment, a production-credential path that is not an author-measured test.
This job is a housekeeping bot that opens the develop to main release pull request and performs no author-measurable testing.
This job is the A38 guard itself, which audits the author report rather than being part of it.
